'''Mahogany trees''' are trees that may be grown with the [[Farming]] [[skill]]. Level 55 farmers may grow a mahogany tree by planting a [[mahogany sapling]] in a [[hardwood tree patch]] using a [[spade]]. When planted, the nearby farmer will watch over a growing mahogany tree in exchange for 25 [[Yanillian hops]], which may be noted. 

A mahogany tree sapling will take 8 hardwood [[growth tick|growth ticks]] (at most 5,120 minutes or approximately 3 days, 13 hours, and 20 minutes) to grow to mature. Once mature, the tree grows into a [[mahogany]] tree which can be harvested for [[mahogany logs]].

If buying the [[mahogany seed]] and [[Yanillian hops]] on the [[Grand Exchange]], it will cost around {{Coins|{{GEP|Mahogany seed}}+{{GEP|Yanillian_hops|25}}}} per tree, assuming one pays a gardener.

Unlike trees found naturally, grown Mahogany trees have a 1/8 chance to be temporarily depleted per log cut.
